summary: Tested the 6 fixes reported by the user (faithfulness, templates per module, plausibility Correggi, free-visit patient creation, neutral texts, labels/toast). Backend: test_mantai_faithfulness.py passed 3 times out of 3. Regression step2 + step3 + gyn_minor_guardian passed 20 of 20. The new test_fixes_iter73.py passed 5 of 6; the failure is an orphan patient created when the visit is rejected. I read the riepilogo by hand: values only, no alto/basso/normale/prosegua. One small paraphrase: 'ritmo sinusale' became 'ritmo regolare del cuore'. Templates: cardiologo templates are all on cardiologia; PUT module_id saves and persists; a new template gets cardiologia. A Dermatologia visit that forces a cardiology template_id has no cardiology sezioni (no Fattori di rischio, Auscultazione or ECG) and motivo is filled. Frontend: overlay heading 'Chi sta visitando?'. Cartella=Cardiologia shows 4 cardiology pills; Dermatologia hides the template row entirely. The free-name new-patient box (birth date + F/M) works: starting without it shows an error hint; with it plus paper consent the visit is created, the patient appears in Pazienti and the visit is linked (patient_id). Motivo is filled ('Palpitazioni da una settimana'). As medico, typing 'Aurora' shows a suggestion for Aurora Ricci; 'Usa questa scheda' selects it and hides the new-patient form. Pediatric overlay still shows the Bilanci section; Generale shows no template picker. Correggi on sistolica 1200 leaves sistolica empty and diastolica at 80. The transcript label reads 'TRASCRIZIONE · MANTAI', with no 'Whisper'. Cardiologo Area personale has no Bilanci tile; the pediatrician still has it. The Modelli Visita card explains how it relates to the Cartella. template-module-select (Cartella: Cardiologia/Dermatologia/Generale) saved dermatologia, persisted after reload, and was restored to cardiologia. Other checks: 'Messaggi dai pazienti' heading; neutral bio placeholder; Team text 'delega del paziente o del tutore'; register CF label 'Codice fiscale del paziente (lei o chi assiste)' with neutral Nome/Cognome; portal shows 'Collega un'altra cartella'. Toast auto-dismiss (6s + dismiss) was checked in code only.

minor.issue: free_visit_patient() creates the patient and consent BEFORE visit_setup validates module_id, and before the other checks. If the request is rejected (e.g. module_id='ginecologia' for cardiologo -> 400), an orphan patient is left behind. A retry after any later error (upload, Whisper, live transcript 409) creates a DUPLICATE patient each time. There is also no server-side duplicate check on name+birth_date. Reproduced by test_invalid_module_does_not_create_orphan_patient.

ui_bugs.issue: A waiting-room entry without patient_id (WaitingPatient.patient_id is Optional; e.g. POST /api/waiting {name, clinic, reason}) is a dead end. Selecting it and clicking Genera nota clinica shows 'Indichi data di nascita e sesso: verrà creata la scheda del paziente', but the NewPatient form is not shown because freeName is empty. The paper-consent checkbox is not shown either (ConsentGate free = !patient_id && freeName). The visit cannot be started. Fix: render NewPatient/ConsentGate when sel exists without patient_id (use sel.name), or skip the check for that case.

issues: consult-new-patient-birth is a native <input type=date> (shows the browser default 'mm/dd/yyyy' picker, US order in an Italian UI). Use the shadcn Calendar/date picker or an Italian gg/mm/aaaa format.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the overlay dead end for waiting-room entries without patient_id: show the NewPatient (birth date/sex) and paper-consent UI for them, or skip the birth-date requirement for them.

Move free_visit_patient() after visit_setup()/validation in both /consultations and /consultations/start, so a rejected request does not create an orphan patient. Consider idempotency/dedup (same name + birth_date + owner) so retries do not duplicate patients.

Neutralise the remaining pediatric texts listed in design_issues (Register consent 'mio figlio', AI Risposte hint 'famiglie', nav 'Messaggi con le famiglie', Conversation/TeamState/PatientDialog/PartyFields 'genitore/bambino') for non-pediatric doctors and adult patients.
Replace the native date input in the overlay NewPatient with the shadcn date picker (Italian format).
Optional: patient_summary prompt. 'ritmo sinusale' was paraphrased to 'ritmo regolare del cuore'. 'regolare' is mildly interpretive; consider requiring the doctor's term to be kept.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_consultation/start_consultation: patient creation is a side effect before validation (orphan/duplicate patients).
ConsultationOverlay.jsx:138 the birth-date/sex requirement applies to every !sel?.patient_id, but NewPatient is only rendered for a typed freeName.
NewPatient suggestions match by substring only ('Ricci Aurora' does not match 'Aurora Ricci'); minor.
visit_templates.py PUT sets modified=True even when only module_id changes; harmless, but it affects pending-fields logic for seeded templates.

test_mantai_faithfulness.py cleanup hardcodes the DB name 'mantmed' and a MONGO_URL default; it should use os.environ DB_NAME/MONGO_URL from backend/.env. It also deletes by patient_name only (delete_one), not by the returned id.
